_note: v2.3 L3 part b (plan 05 recipe, real judge): the continuity warden must never correct the story toward a QUARANTINED fact, and a positive control in the same session proves it runs and flags a LIVE one. Fact A (the eastern tower burned) is planted from the player's own line, pinned, then quarantined by editing that line. Fact B (the stone bridge collapsed) is seeded live, as J8.5 does. A courier contradicts A: a warden call must run and no warden note may cite A. The courier then contradicts B: an accepted warden note must cite B. Judge and stagecraft settings are captured first and put back in the last step. Run with --sandbox --group 1759606632088.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const root = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; const status = await fetch('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge/status', { headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders() }).then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : null)).catch(() => null); if (!status?.configured) throw new Error(`judge plugin not reachable or not configured: ${JSON.stringify(status)}`); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.__l3b = { judge: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(root.settings.judge)), stagecraft: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rt.getStagecraftState().settings)) }; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, enabled: true, timeoutMs: 20000, uses: Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(root.settings.judge.uses).map((key) => [key, false])) }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 50 }); rt.setStagecraftSettings({ curatorEnabled: false, wardenEnabled: true, wardenAcceptMode: 'auto' }); return { saved: globalThis.__l3b.stagecraft, now: rt.getStagecraftState().settings };

steps.send: On the road the ferryman tells us the eastern tower burned down last winter.

extract.debugResponse: FACT importance=3 text="The eastern tower burned down last winter." evidence="the eastern tower burned down last winter"

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const fact = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.text.includes('eastern tower')); if (!fact || fact.messageId === undefined) throw new Error('fact A did not land with a source message'); rt.setMemoryPinned(fact.id, true); globalThis.__l3b.a = { id: fact.id, source: fact.messageId }; return globalThis.__l3b.a;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = globalThis.__l3b.a.source; const message = ctx.chat[id]; if (!message || !message.is_user) throw new Error(`message ${id} is not the player's source line`); const text = 'On the road the ferryman talks only about the weather.'; message.mes = text; if (Array.isArray(message.swipes) && Number.isInteger(message.swipe_id)) message.swipes[message.swipe_id] = text; await ctx.updateMessageBlock?.(id, message); await ctx.saveChat?.(); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_EDITED, id); return { edited: id };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const row = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__l3b.a.id); if (row?.provenance?.validity !== 'source-removed') throw new Error(`fact A was not quarantined: ${JSON.stringify(row?.provenance ?? null)}`); if (!rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.some((entry) => entry.text === 'The old stone bridge over the river collapsed in the flood and is gone.')) await rt.applyExtractionAudit({ id: 'l3b-live-seed', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: 'manual', contractHash: 'h', scope: [], window: { from: 100000, to: 100000 }, prompt: 'p', rawResponse: 'r', acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [] }, [], [{ tier: 'facts', type: 'fact', importance: 3, expiration: 'permanent', entities: [], text: 'The old stone bridge over the river collapsed in the flood and is gone.', evidence: 'the flood took the bridge' }]); const live = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.text.includes('stone bridge')); if (!live || (live.provenance && live.provenance.validity !== 'live')) throw new Error('fact B is not live'); const records = () => rt.getStagecraftState().proposals.filter((record) => record.curator === 'warden'); const calls = () => rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge warden')); globalThis.__l3b.records = records().length; globalThis.__l3b.calls = calls().length; return { quarantined: row.provenance.validity, pinned: row.pinned, live: live.id, records: globalThis.__l3b.records, calls: globalThis.__l3b.calls };

steps.slash: /sendas name="Courier" raw=false "I rode past the eastern tower this morning. It stands whole, not a scorch mark on its stones."

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const until = async (probe, ms) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; while (Date.now() < end) { const value = probe(); if (value) return value; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); } return null; }; const calls = () => rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge warden')); const ran = await until(() => (calls().length > globalThis.__l3b.calls ? calls().at(-1) : null), 60000); if (!ran) throw new Error('no warden call ran after the reply contradicting the quarantined fact, so this proves nothing about what it was shown'); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 3000)); const records = rt.getStagecraftState().proposals.filter((record) => record.curator === 'warden').slice(globalThis.__l3b.records); const citing = records.filter((record) => JSON.stringify(record.ops ?? []).toLowerCase().includes('eastern tower')); if (citing.length) throw new Error(`the warden corrected toward the QUARANTINED fact: ${JSON.stringify(citing.map((record) => record.ops))}`); globalThis.__l3b.records += records.length; globalThis.__l3b.calls = calls().length; return { warden: ran.summary, notes: records.map((record) => ({ status: record.ops?.[0]?.status, facts: record.ops?.[0]?.op?.facts ?? null })) };

steps.slash: /sendas name="Courier" raw=false "I crossed the old stone bridge over the river this morning. It held firm under my boots, same as ever."

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const until = async (probe, ms) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; while (Date.now() < end) { const value = probe(); if (value) return value; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); } return null; }; const record = await until(() => rt.getStagecraftState().proposals.filter((entry) => entry.curator === 'warden').slice(globalThis.__l3b.records).find((entry) => entry.ops?.[0]?.status === 'accepted'), 60000); const last = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge warden')).at(-1); if (!record) throw new Error(`positive control failed: no accepted warden note for the live bridge fact, so 'did not flag the tower' could mean 'never flags'; last call: ${JSON.stringify(last ?? null)}`); const text = JSON.stringify(record.ops).toLowerCase(); if (!text.includes('bridge')) throw new Error(`the accepted note is not about the live bridge fact: ${JSON.stringify(record.ops)}`); if (text.includes('eastern tower')) throw new Error(`the control note also cites the quarantined tower fact: ${JSON.stringify(record.ops)}`); return { note: record.ops[0].op.text, facts: record.ops[0].op.facts ?? null };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const root = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.judge = globalThis.__l3b.judge; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); rt.setStagecraftSettings(globalThis.__l3b.stagecraft); rt.stagecraft?.clearContinuityNote?.(); return { restored: rt.getStagecraftState().settings, judgeEnabled: root.settings.judge.enabled };
